Stop! Aries, the cosmos is throwing a bright, restless fire at your natal chart.

Mars, your ruling planet, squares Saturn in your 7th House, pushing you to prove independence in partnerships. Venus in Gemini trines your 5th House Sun, sparking creative energy. Mercury’s retrograde shadow in your 2nd House adds financial caution, urging careful budgeting, and Mars’s square sharpens your competitive edge in workouts.

If you're single, a passionate new connection may spark as the Mars-Saturn square urges loyalty testing. If you're taken, watch for ego clashes—Mars-square-Saturn makes both stubborn, so pause before demanding control.

Your 10th House ruler Jupiter sextiles Mercury, boosting business and a modest unexpected bonus. Networking opportunities also shine under this sextile for you.

Avoid signing legal paperwork under Mars-Saturn tension, but a surprise talent opportunity is waiting in the creative arts.
